page.title: Jam mako
page.intro: Keth akaunti peri mi yungu pi lworu piny. Ju ma bino i ads peri bino i My Leads kende kende, ku wel piny ma jutiyo kudu man wel pa dhanu acel acel.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form tero dhanu i My Leads, wel piny ma jutiyo kudu kubang ceng man wel pa dhanu acel acel, man ber pa dhanu ma jucwalo i LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

connect.title: Rib LinkedIn
connect.intro: Dony ku akaunti LinkedIn ma gwoko ads peri. Leadrat kwano kende kende akaunti peri mi ad, Lead Gen Form leads man ad statistics, man cwalu aloka loka ma i loko.
connect.need1: Tic moko iwi LinkedIn ad account (Janen nyo ma malu).
connect.need2: Tic moko iwi karatasi mi kampuni (Jatel wi tic, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Jatel wi lembe nyo Janen wi lembe) - LinkedIn mito ni epok dhanu.
connect.need3: Penji mi namba cim iwi Lead Gen Forms - ju ma gipe ku namba cim gicopo medu ngo.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Wec ni LinkedIn nia ngati makani ma udoko jatel wi dhanu mandha. Ka ngati moko ma ucungo iwi LinkedIn utuc i rwom ma iyero piny eno, Leadrat cwalo ripot ni LinkedIn , wek ripot peri mi yub unyuth ber pa dhanu man LinkedIn unwangu dhanu mapol ma gimaru dhanu peri maber. LinkedIn lead ID man one-way hash pa email kende re ma juoro.
capi.rules: Nyuthu pa kite ma piny utiye kudu
capi.created: Lokruok ma juyubu i LinkedIn man juporo.
